summary: Topics knowledge-library UX/UI correction. The stale two-column tiny-square card wall is replaced by the already-approved cover-first 4:3 topic library through a Topics-only terminal body stylesheet. The large outer dashboard panel is removed, factual category/sort/update information is preserved, and desktop/tablet/mobile layout is stabilized. Shared Shell, Navigation, frozen Channels and Watch remain unchanged. No data model, schema, migration, auth/security, provider, or updater mechanism change. Production remains Owner manual.
